request.deadline: 12 months, with midpoint yield return at month 6
deliverables: Deploy 9,000,000 ADA sold for USDM into Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure for 12 months.
Return realized yield from the first six months to the Cardano Treasury at month 6.
Return 100% of treasury-owned deployed assets, including remaining principal and realized yield minus any realized losses, at month 12.

Provide monthly public transparency reports covering deployment status, utilization, volume, open interest, P&L, yield, drawdown, stablecoin exposure, market quality, distributions, and material risks.
Provide third-party assurance reports for deployment confirmation, month-6 yield distribution, and month-12 return of funds.
request.recipient: Independent council composed of Rami from Snek, Phil from Surf, and James from Monetra/Moneta; Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure is the deployment target.
request.what: A 12-month deployment of treasury-owned ADA into Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure, with ADA sold for USDM to provide stablecoin-denominated liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 9,000,000 ADA for a 12-month productive liquidity deployment into Strike Finance V2 rather than grant funding.
The deployed ADA will be sold for USDM, modeled at ADA = 0.15 USD to create approximately 1,350,000 USDM of stablecoin liquidity.

Under modeled assumptions of a 10% USD-denominated annual percentage rate, the deployment is expected to generate about 135,000 USD or 900,000 ADA-equivalent in annual yield, but returns are not guaranteed.

Strike reports more than 1.13 billion USD in cumulative volume, about 968,000 to 1,001,000 trades, over 3,000 unique traders, over 1.16 million USD in protocol revenue, and over 3.25 million USD in liquidity provider profit.
The proposal states that Strike accounted for more than 50% of Cardano trading activity over the past six months.

Strike V2 public data from 2026-03-20 through 2026-06-15 is presented as showing 87,288,044 USD total V2 volume, 410,800 total V2 trades, 2,681 total V2 users, 30,105 USD total V2 revenue, and peak open interest of 1,246,007 USD.

The Strike Liquidity Provider vault is described as having 985,271.59 USD TVL, 43.52% APR, +8.85% all-time return, 1.15% maximum drawdown, and 4.97 Sharpe ratio over two months of public performance history.
Operational custody is proposed through an independent multisig council, with Strike Finance lacking unilateral custody or control of treasury assets.

The proposal states that governance review is triggered at more than 8% drawdown or missed reporting for two consecutive monthly cycles, with mandatory review at 10% drawdown and a separate wind-down review trigger above 20% drawdown.
The proposal states that Strike V2 has unofficial reviews and that an official audit by Christian Schmitz is expected to be finalized by July 1, 2026, with the report to be published upon completion.

summary: The document asks for a 9,000,000 ADA treasury deployment into Strike Finance V2 liquidity for 12 months, with modeled yield, independent multisig custody, monthly reporting, assurance reports, and return of principal plus realized yield, while presenting substantial traction and risk controls but no reference links in the anchor metadata.
